column3: Kirino Route · There's No Way I Get Deja Vú In My Room
Wha-!?
...Keep quiet.
Eh? This development...
Y-You...
Didn't I tell you to keep quiet... What do you think the time is now?
A-Anyway, get off the bed first...
Tch.
So, what are you trying to do?
...I have something to tell you, so come over.
Something to tell me? At this time?
Yes.
I'm really tired, though... Can't it wait until tomorrow?
Tomorrow won't do. It has to be right now.
Why?
...It just has to, no matter what.
Yes, yes. Not saying the reason. Nor bending her insistence. Just how selfish is this girl?
...It feels like we had this exact same exchange one year ago as well.
Hold on for a bit.
What's with that Kirino... It looks like she's revealing her secret collection...
I didn't know about it last year, but what does she want with it now?
...Could it be that she wants to show even more risqué items than the ones up till now?
Actually... about these things...
These things... aren't they her usual otaku stuff?
Besides, what's with that glare in her eyes? It's like she's looking at a criminal.
Ah, the phone.
O-Okay.
...What?
...Don't freely touch the stuff in my room.
Am I really that untrustworthy...?
We may be siblings, but it's common sense to allow each other some privacy at least.
However, I don't get many chances to peer into my sister's room. So I'm slight-ly interested, you see...
...Just a little. I have a feeling I might stumble upon some hidden cache if I sniff around.
......All right.
Ah...
Did you do anything while I wasn't around?
Nothing at all!
It'd be good if that were the case.
